newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends up on world market price, exports.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends up on world market price, exports.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher on Wednesday with support coming from news USDA raised its world market rice price, pit sources said.
Commercial buying interest was noted amid renewed export demand from Central America and the Caribbean.
"There's potential demand under the market," a pit source said. "We're starting to see demand coming out of Central America and the Caribbean at a time when we don't have a lot of supplies."
He was referring to tenders from Costa Rica and Jamaica.
Term Commodities was said to be an aggressive buyer.
USDA on Wednesday raised the world market rice price for long grain whole kernels to 13.28 cts per lb, versus 11.95 cts a week earlier.
Rice ended 5-1/2 to two cents per cwt higher with July up 5-1/2 at $11.31.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 300 lots, compared with Tuesday's actual volume of 691 lots.
